h1: Toppr and Extramarks Alternative for K-12 Teachers: Build Your Own Tuition Academy (2026)
dek: If you teach classes 6 to 12 and want students and parents to know your name, here are your real options in 2026: teach for a platform, work with a school product, or run a tuition academy of your own. Every source is linked and dated.
cover_alt: Moving on from Toppr or Extramarks: a K-12 teacher's options compared, with official sources checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: K-12 school and tuition teachers in India who want to sell chapter-wise courses and classes directly to students and parents
intro: The best Toppr or Extramarks alternative for a K-12 teacher is usually not another big platform but a tuition academy under your own name: your own website, your own app, chapter-wise lessons, tests and live doubt classes that parents pay you for directly. If you would rather earn without selling, teaching for an online tuition platform is the other honest path, and many teachers do both.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. To keep it fair, every fact about another company comes from its own website, linked and dated, and we say plainly where another path suits you better than ours.

Two facts shape this guide. Toppr's website did not respond when we checked on 24 Oct 2026, so we cannot describe its current product or teacher terms. Extramarks describes itself as a provider of solutions for schools, teachers, students and parents, and lists no educator programme or prices on its homepage. So this is less a product-versus-product comparison and more a guide to your choices as a K-12 teacher.
takeaways: Toppr's website (toppr.com) did not respond on 24 Oct 2026, so its current product and teacher terms could not be checked. If you work with Toppr, ask it for current terms directly.
Extramarks sells to schools, teachers, students and parents; its homepage lists no prices and no programme for independent educators (checked 24 Oct 2026).

Teaching for a platform pays you, but the platform owns the brand. Vedantu, for example, states earning potential of "₹ 25,000+ per month @ 4h/day upto ₹ 75,000+ per month for full time" on its teacher page; that is Vedantu's own claim.
Building your own tuition academy means parents pay you directly and know your name; the trade-off is that finding students becomes your job.
AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales (Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5%, or monthly at 0% commission from ₹3,999), GST extra, with a 7-day free trial and no card needed.
Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year; on published prices it costs less than AllCoaching once you sell above ₹2.3 lakh a year, before any fee it may charge.
If you teach in a school, check your school's and board's rules on private tuition before you sell to its students.

sections.h2: The short answer: three paths for a K-12 teacher
sections.html:
A K-12 teacher who wants to move beyond Toppr or Extramarks has three paths: teach for an online platform, keep using a school product where your school chooses it, or build a tuition academy under your own name. Pick by what you want more of: steady pay, or your own brand.

{{fig:verdict|Which Toppr or Extramarks alternative fits a K-12 teacher: own tuition brand, AllCoaching; steady pay without selling, teach for a platform such as Vedantu; school already uses Extramarks, keep it in class; flat-price app, Classplus|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each path.}}

Many teachers combine paths. They keep a teaching job or platform income and build a small academy of their own on the side, so the new income grows before the old one stops.

We looked at the choices a K-12 teacher in India actually has, not only at software. For each path we asked five questions.

  1. How you earn: a salary or per-hour pay from a platform, or fees that parents pay you directly.
  2. Whose name the student remembers: the platform's brand or yours.
  3. What it costs you, taken only from each company's own website.
  4. Who sets the fee and the syllabus plan for your batch.
  5. Who finds the students: the platform's sales and marketing, or you.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Facts about other companies link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Terms change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why K-12 teachers look beyond Toppr and Extramarks
sections.html:
Most teachers who search for a Toppr or Extramarks alternative want the same thing: students and parents who know them by name and pay them directly. Big K-12 brands built national reach, and that took capital, content teams and sales teams no single teacher can match. The question is what fits you now.

1. Toppr cannot be checked today

When we tried toppr.com on 24 Oct 2026, the site did not respond.[1] We therefore do not describe Toppr's current product, prices or teacher arrangements here. If you teach with Toppr or bought from it, ask it in writing for current terms before planning around them.

2. Extramarks is built for schools

Extramarks describes "Cutting-Edge Solutions for Schools, Teachers, Students, and Parents": smart class, an assessment centre and a learning app.[2] If your school uses it, it can be a useful classroom tool. But its homepage lists no programme for independent educators and no prices, so it is not a way to sell your own tuition.

{{q:I teach in a school. Can I sell my own tuition online?|Often yes, but check first. Your school, and the board your school follows, may have rules about private tuition, especially for students you teach in class. Read your appointment letter and school policy before you sell. Many school teachers teach students from other schools, or teach a different class level, online.}}

3. Wanting your own name on your teaching

A parent choosing tuition looks for a few things: a syllabus that matches the board and class, a sample lesson, test results that improve, and a teacher they can name. When the teaching sits inside a large brand, the brand gets the credit. When it sits in your own academy, the next admission comes to you.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after for a K-12 tutor: notes on WhatsApp groups, fees by UPI screenshot, tests on Google Forms and class links sent daily, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, chapter tests and checkout|Whichever path you choose, aim for one place for lessons, tests, fees and students.}}

sections.h2: What a direct-to-student K-12 academy should contain
sections.html:
A K-12 academy that parents trust needs four things: lessons that follow the board's chapter order, tests that show progress, a regular live doubt class with you, and clear fees. Build these first; everything else can wait.

Chapter-wise lessons in your own words

Record lessons chapter by chapter, in the order your board follows (CBSE, ICSE or your state board), and in the language your students learn in. Short videos per topic and a PDF note per chapter are easier to sell than one long course. Our guide to an online tuition app for Class 10 and 12 CBSE teachers covers board-wise course plans.

Chapter tests and full-syllabus tests

A parent sees value in a score that improves. Add a short test after each chapter and a full-syllabus test before exams. See how to create mock tests online.

Doubt solving under your own name

A weekly live doubt class, on YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in live room, is where students get to know you. On AllCoaching, live classes are unlimited on every plan.

Fees parents can pay in a minute

Monthly, term-wise or full-year fees with UPI or card checkout, and access that starts the moment the fee is paid. In AllCoaching this runs on its own, with automatic payouts through Razorpay.

School teacher with a few evening hours

Start small with one subject and one class level, after checking your school's rules on private tuition. A self-serve academy with a 7-day trial lets you test demand before paying much. See side income from online coaching for school teachers.

Home tutor for classes 6 to 10

Parents in your area already know you; move them online with your own website and app, then add students from other cities. Building a recognisable name matters here: see personal branding for educators.

Class 11 and 12 teacher with board plus JEE or NEET foundation

Test series carry more weight. Build chapter tests and full mocks into your academy, and price board and entrance batches separately.

Teacher on a platform who wants a brand later

Keep the platform income while you build a small academy on the side, if your contract allows it. Shift the balance only when your own students are enough.

Tuition centre with several teachers

Look for separate teacher logins and batch ownership. AllCoaching includes multi-teacher institutes on every plan; see running a multi-teacher coaching platform.

faq: What can I use instead of Toppr or Extramarks to sell my courses directly to students?

A tuition academy under your own name is the main alternative: your own website and app where parents pay you directly. AllCoaching gives you this from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales, with a 7-day free trial. Classplus is another app builder, listing ₹29,999 a year.
What are Toppr and Extramarks good at?

Extramarks offers digital learning for schools, including smart class, an assessment centre and a learning app. Toppr's website did not respond on 24 Oct 2026, so we could not check its current product; ask Toppr directly for current details.
Does Extramarks have a programme for independent teachers?

Its homepage lists no programme for independent educators and no prices (checked 24 Oct 2026). Extramarks describes solutions for schools, teachers, students and parents, so teachers usually meet it through their school.
Is teaching for a platform better than running my own tuition academy?

It depends on what you want. A platform pays you and finds students, but the brand is the platform's. Your own academy lets parents pay you directly and know your name, but you must find students. Many teachers do both for a while.
How much does it cost to run my own K-12 tuition academy online?

On AllCoaching, Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales, Growth ₹12,999 plus 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 plus 5%, or monthly at 0% commission from ₹3,999, GST extra. Every plan includes your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) and unlimited live classes.
Can a school teacher sell tuition online?
Often yes, but check your school's rules and your board's rules on private tuition first, especially for students you teach in class. Read your appointment letter before you start.
Can I teach several subjects or classes from one academy?
Yes. You can create separate courses and batches for each subject and class level in one academy, and add other teachers with their own logins.
How long does it take to launch my own K-12 teaching app?
You can set up the academy, connect your domain and upload a first chapter-wise course during the 7-day trial. Start with one subject and one class, then add more.
